comment: Data Corrupter-inspired monophonic PLL synth-fuzz approximation. Tracks the input pitch and regenerates square-wave master, divided subharmonic, and FM-modulated harmony voices. Best on single-note lines; ambiguous input can cause octave jumps. Pedal build fixes the root mode to Unison and does not model the independent Square voice.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category used by the existing Corrupt release effect.
fxid_comment: 0x01C6 = above the repo's used range, distinct from microloom(450)/flower(451)/shatter(452)/arrakis(453). Verify uniqueness before flashing.

params.name: Master
params.comment: Tracked master oscillator pitch: unison, one octave down, or two octaves down.

params.name: Sub
params.comment: Level of the divided square subharmonic, one octave below the Master.

params.name: Harm
params.comment: Selects unison, fifth, octave, fourth, sub-octave, or 12th harmony.

params.name: Depth
params.comment: Frequency-modulator pitch depth, up to approximately three semitones.

audio_nop_comment: Full pedal DSP is compiled from corrupt.c.
